posts.cooked:
I looked through the measly 3 logs we have on here (Escher's unlock, jsalomon617's unlock, and my fail) to see if there's any clear pattern with draws or discards.  All of us played the prerequisite games and played Trust Fund at least 3 times.

Escher's Wraith drew 67 cards, jsalomon's drew 35, and mine drew 32.  So unless the cutoff for drawing is 33, 34, or 35, that's not it. 

Escher's Wraith discarded 19 cards, jsalomon's discarded 10, and mine discarded 12.  So it can't be purely number of discards.

Looking at the ratio of draws to discards, the unlocks were 3.5 or more and my fail was 2.67, but it probably isn't just that, because you could get that by just drawing a lot and hardly ever discarding.  It could be something like discard at least 10 cards and draw at least 3 times as many cards as you discarded, but that seems unlikely.

I also looked at draws and discards relative to how many turns The Wraith had.  Escher's Wraith had 23 turns for 2.91 draws/turn and 0.826 discards/turn.  jsalomon's Wraith had 9 turns for 3.89 draws/turn and 1.11 discards/turn.  My Wraith had 10 turns for 3.2 draws/turn and 1.2 discards/turn.  So it definitely doesn't seem like there's anything there.

Also, for those concerned about Impromptu Invention, Escher played it 7 times, jsalomon617 played it 2 times, and I played it 3 times. Edit: apparently I played it 4 times.  One of them was with Tachyon's incap ability, so it was listed as Tachyon plays instead of Wraith plays, so I missed it.  Still doesn't change anything though.

Now that we have a general sense of what needs to be done, we really need more logs to analyze the nitty gritty details.

Now I made a list of all the cards played by The Wraith in all 5 unlock logs in this thread as well as my fail log.  Let's see what they have in common.

Cards played in all successes:

Impromptu Intervention (at least 2)

Infrared Eyepiece (at least 1)

Smoke Bombs (at least 1)

Trust Fund (at least 3)

Cards not played in any success (and thus possibly, but probably not, forbidden):

Combat Stance

Inventory Barrage

Comparing this list to my fail log, the only difference is that I didn't play Smoke Bombs.  So I'm pretty sure that's the key.  The next thing to test is whether or not they actually need to redirect and/or reduce damage or just be played.  All of the success logs so far have them redirecting and reducing damage, but the log on Steam that MindWanderer mentioned only does it once, so at least there's no required number of times.

So based on all that, my guess is:  After completing the prerequisite losses against Progeny, defeat Progeny with the base Freedom Five in Megalopolis.  The Wraith must play Trust Fund at least 3 times.  Smoke Bombs must redirect damage at least once.  (Not sure if we need to include something about Impromptu Invention and/or Infrared Eyepiece or if they were just coincidences)
